findings.desc: Verification for CHK-001/CHK-002 does not cover the actual koala entrypoint the user runs. In this worktree, npm run test:gap-coverage-smoke and node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check both report 0 high gaps / 100% coverage, but koala gap_analyze and koala convergence_check still report 10 high gaps / 88% coverage. WHY: the stored evidence only proves the local dist/task path, so REVIEW cannot treat high-gap/coverage convergence as covered for the canonical koala command path. Severity: high because the checklist userSees promise is terminal-visible convergence output and the current koala command contradicts it.
